approaches.name: Check every substring
approaches.intuition: Try each start, extend until a character repeats, and track the longest run.
approaches.time: O(n * k) where k is the alphabet size, O(n^2) in general

approaches.name: Sliding window with last-seen positions
approaches.intuition: The window only ever moves right. A repeat tells you exactly how far to move the left edge.
steps: Remember the last index of every character
On a repeat inside the window, jump `left` past it
pitfalls: Only move `left` forward, never back: use the maximum of the old and the new value.
A character seen before the window started does not matter.

talkTrackMd: Explain the window invariant (no repeats inside), how a repeat moves the left edge, and why each character is visited a constant number of times.
